name: Accidental Killings
overview: Scripture affirms the sanctity of human life as made in God's image, declaring that shedding man's blood demands serious accountability (Genesis 9:5-6). The commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13) underscores this principle, yet the law also distinguishes between intentional murder and accidental death, providing refuge for those who kill unintentionally (Exodus 21:12-13). Additionally, consequences are prescribed for causing harm without fatal intent, as seen in the case of injury to a pregnant woman resulting in the loss of her child (Exodus 21:22), highlighting God's justice balanced with mercy in cases of accidental harm.
